raw_text: 中尼铁路框架协议签署。Nepal-China trans-Himalayan railway framework signed. Kerung to Kathmandu route. USD 3.5B Chinese financing through BRI framework. This is a landmark connectivity project that Beijing has been pushing for years. Engineering feasibility remains questionable given Himalayan terrain but political will appears strong on both sides.
clean_text: Nepal-China trans-Himalayan railway framework signed. Kerung-Kathmandu route. USD 3.5B BRI financing. Beijing pushing for years, engineering feasibility questioned.
